$sources: Standard 2800 (4th ed.) Chapter 2 (A, soil types, B = B1 N, I) and Chapter 3 (C = A B I / Ru, the minimum 0.12 A I, the period, Ru, Ω0 and Cd, the vertical distribution, the drift); see VERIFY.md
source: Standard 2800 (4th ed.): C = A B I / Ru with B = B1 N of the soil type (B1 = S0 + (S - S0 + 1) T/T0 below T0, S + 1 to Ts, (S + 1) Ts/T beyond; N = 1 to Ts, rising linearly to 1.7 at 4 s in the zones of very high and high hazard, to 1.4 in the moderate and low zones, constant beyond), at least 0.12 A I; by the generic shapeFactors spectrum method (A as Z, Ru as μ, Sp = 1, kμ = μ). The soil parameters of the moderate and low zones differ (N, and S0, S of soil type IV): each soil type has a site class for zones 1-2 (I-IV) and one for zones 3-4 (IL-IVL). Entered from knowledge of the standard, every value to be checked against the printed standard (VERIFY.md).

I.description: Soil type I, zones of very high and high hazard: rock and very dense soil (vs above 750 m/s; T0 0.1 s, Ts 0.4 s, S0 1.0, S 1.5)

II.description: Soil type II, zones of very high and high hazard: dense soil and soft rock (vs 375-750 m/s; T0 0.1 s, Ts 0.5 s, S0 1.0, S 1.5)

III.description: Soil type III, zones of very high and high hazard: medium dense soil (vs 175-375 m/s; T0 0.15 s, Ts 0.7 s, S0 1.1, S 1.75)

IV.description: Soil type IV, zones of very high and high hazard: soft soil (vs below 175 m/s; T0 0.15 s, Ts 1.0 s, S0 1.1, S 1.75)

IL.description: Soil type I, zones of moderate and low hazard (T0 0.1 s, Ts 0.4 s, S0 1.0, S 1.5; N up to 1.4)

IIL.description: Soil type II, zones of moderate and low hazard (T0 0.1 s, Ts 0.5 s, S0 1.0, S 1.5; N up to 1.4)

IIIL.description: Soil type III, zones of moderate and low hazard (T0 0.15 s, Ts 0.7 s, S0 1.1, S 1.75; N up to 1.4)

IVL.description: Soil type IV, zones of moderate and low hazard (T0 0.15 s, Ts 1.0 s, S0 1.3, S 2.25; N up to 1.4)
